chunks: "Whatever is placed on the grave that is not from the soil of the grave itself is a burden upon the deceased."

key_terms.اَلصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, the speaker of the hadith
key_terms.اَلْقَبْرِ: the grave, the burial place of the deceased
key_terms.تُرَابِ: soil or earth, specifically the grave's own earth
key_terms.ثِقْلٌ: a burden or weight upon someone

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Ṣadiq عليه السلام say about placing things on a grave?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that placing anything upon a grave, other than its own soil, is a burden upon the deceased. The hadith indicates disapproval of adding extraneous material to the grave and relates this act to the condition of the dead.
